title: Board Service Service State
description: Runs a saved board as a sub-pipeline, forwarding incoming data through it and emitting the result. (Runtimes: browser; IDs: hookup.to/service/board-service)

bypass.description: When true, the runtime skips this service and passes input straight through.

selectedBoard.description: Name or identifier of the saved board to run

result.description: Internal — used by the UI to deliver a result back into the pipeline
